1: An unfamiliar store parking lot, and a pregnant seventeen-year-old left all alone by an empty space.
2: But her boyfriend never comes back, and all she has left is five dollars and fifty-five cents.
3: With the store closing and nowhere to go, Novalee hides in a bathroom stall.
4: A mother-to-be who can't tear herself away from the baby cribs.
5: Days of sleeping in a store sleeping bag and washing up at the sink.
6: When day breaks, she hides away in the storeroom.
7: A nail-biting game of hide-and-seek through the crack in the door.
8: She sneaks out and makes do with meals on a park bench.
9: Up at 5:30 a.m., she always moves one step ahead of the staff.
10: Everything she uses goes faithfully into a notebook, titled: what I owe Walmart.
11: Weeks later, a night of pouring rain.
12: Waking up and packing her things, she clutches her belly as labor begins.
13: Her water has broken, but there is no one in the empty store to help.
14: After holding out as long as she can, she finally collapses to the floor.
15: Will mother and baby make it?
16: Thankfully, mother and daughter are both fine. She wakes up in a hospital bed.
17: The gentle touch of a warm-hearted nurse, Lexie.
18: Money worries forgotten for a moment: her daughter, in her arms for the first time.
19: The one who delivered the baby was Forney, the librarian who crashed through the glass window.
